issues.description: The problem statement/tasks require implementing getters for each attribute (and the tests reference getLectureName and getNumberOfInscribedStudents), implying public access. In the solution implementation, getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() are declared private, while other getters are public. This visibility mismatch is structural and will prevent students/tests from accessing these getters as intended.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getter methods for all attributes public. Specifically change getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() from private to public so their visibility matches the problem requirements and the other getters, ensuring consistency with the expected tests.
